**The held-out arm of the layer-0 node (iteration-9 correction).** The layer-0 MLP at the condition span has a held-out effect of exactly 0.00 nats under ablation and steering because the held-out edit was never applied. The class means that the edit writes are taken, for a condition-span node, only over pair prompts of the held-out prompt's own template (`MeanCache.get` in `src/k3circuit.py`, line 482: `if cl == "COND" and p["template"] != ref["template"]:`; line 485 also skips prompts whose span length differs). The 10 held-out prompts are templates F11 to F15 and the 20 pair prompts F1 to F10, so 0 of the 10 held-out prompts has a matching pair prompt, the mean is None (line 488), no edit is built, and the edited and unedited margins coincide; the stored rows show the node and all 50 matched random components of the same class at exactly 0 on every held-out prompt (20 of 20 prompt-by-mode rows). The node's 5.43 nats (ablation) and 4.94 nats (steering) over 30 prompts are therefore 8.14 and 7.41 nats over the 20 pair prompts plus ten zeros (8.14 x 20 / 30 = 5.43); the identity mean x 30 = pair mean x 20 + held-out mean x 10 holds for every node of both tables, and no other node has an exact-zero held-out effect (1 node in all, under both modes). Its held-out status is untested, not failed: on the descriptive natural contrast, whose held-out prompts share templates with its pairs, the same node gives 0.28 nats under ablation and 0.25 under steering on 5 held-out prompts (sign-flip p 0.031, the smallest one-sided p that five prompts allow, 1/32). BASE (B3) of iteration 9 reruns the held-out arm with template-matched means.

examples.input: The committed composition depends on the attribution screen, which missed Qwen3-8B's largest node; with the exhaustive sweep, the condition share of the primary contrast rises to 0.17 and the picture matches Gemma qualitatively: a layer-0 MLP at the condition span injects the instruction, and a late stack of fork-position MLPs and heads turns it into the fork logit. In Qwen3-8B that stack sits deeper (effect-weighted depth about 0.86 against 0.69).
examples.output: The committed composition depends on the attribution screen, which missed Qwen3-8B's largest node; with the exhaustive sweep, the condition share of the primary contrast rises to 0.17, still below Gemma's band [0.21, 0.51], and every minimum spanning tree row keeps a fork-stack depth of 0.86 to 0.96, above the band [0.45, 0.80] (the bands are constants of the committed motif code, `src/k3motif.py` line 55), so the post hoc sweep does not turn the committed different-motif reading into a match (iteration-9 correction). What the two families share is a late stack of fork-position MLPs and heads that carries the fork logit, deeper in Qwen3-8B (effect-weighted depth about 0.86 against 0.69); the layer-0 MLP at the condition span carries much of the forced contrast on the 20 pair prompts, but its held-out edit was never applied (see the paragraph after Table 395), and a structural likeness or difference between discovered circuits is not by itself a likeness or difference of mechanism, the phantom specialization that Bayat Makou et al. describe [146].
